text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, I want to become the number one horse girl in Japan,
one that my mom can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna give it everythin' I've got from now on,
so please take good care of me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
